name: fitness-pr
title_zh: 分支推上去之前，它先替你查一遍敏感文件
tagline_zh: 写完代码最怕 PR 里混进 .env 或密钥。它按固定顺序走：先查分支卫生和敏感文件，再跑共享验证。
tagline_en: Terrified your PR leaks a .env or key? It runs branch hygiene, sensitive-file checks, shared verification, then.
desc_en: Prepare, verify, create, or update a FitnessApp pull request from an existing branch. Use for branch hygiene, shared verification, sensitive-file checks, commit/push steps, PR metadata, and check monitoring. Do not use for feature implementation or standalone code review.
why_zh: 把「提交前该做的事」固化成一条不可跳步的流水线，敏感文件检查排在 commit 之前。
why_en: Turns pre-commit hygiene into one ordered pipeline: sensitive-file checks run before commit, not after a reviewer spots the leak.
limit_zh: 只处理已存在的分支，不写功能、不做独立代码审查；仓库得先配好共享验证命令和 PR 模板，否则它只能空跑检查步骤。
limit_en: Only works on an existing branch; no feature work or standalone review. Needs shared verification commands and a PR template already configured.
title_en: Checks sensitive files before you push a branch
